description:
Activate Death Cultist by sacrificing it.
When Death Cultist dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Death Cultist from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Death Cultist ability
Activate Death Cultist by sacrificing it.
When Death Cultist dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Death Cultist from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Death Cultist ability
Repeat
